name: The Float Never Stops
storyline:
The Tuna Parade was supposed to be an easy score. Your crew hijacked a float full of tuna for the Boss. Easy. One problem: The cops saw you. Bigger problem: you clipped a manhole and the tuna went everywhere.

Now you gotta get the tuna back on the float or there’s no score. No score would put the Boss’s whiskers in a twist. And the cops are after you, so this float cannot stop moving.
summary: A co-op heist where the getaway vehicle is a parade float. Grab boxes of tuna and whatever junk you find on the street, stack it, and pray it doesn’t fall over because this Float Never Stops.
